trust_decision.summary: Whether a label/character-string length fits its single length octet before MessageEncoder writes it; decided in Label::Str#initialize, MessageEncoder#put_label and #put_string, and these checks are ALREADY PRESENT at the pinned commit. The listed fix commits only bump VERSION.

landing_point.why: The summary names MessageEncoder writing a label length into one octet; put_label/put_string is that write.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Nothing to dismiss: the protection is already applied at every label/name construction path at the pinned commit; the only remaining encoder narrowings (RDLENGTH via put_length16) concern a different field the advisory does not name.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: TXT character-strings of 64..255 octets must still encode via put_string; a 63-octet limit leaking into put_string would break them (already tested).

O6_input_shapes: Array of String labels via Name.new
search domains from Config via Label.split

O8_uncovered_routes.route: put_length16 packs the RDATA/SvcParam length with 'n' without a 65535 range check, so oversized rdata wraps mod 65536 (same encoder, different length field).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory is about the label length octet, not RDLENGTH; different field and needs >64 KiB rdata.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~40 lines from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Name.new and put_labels do not enforce the 255-octet total name limit (only Name.create does), so a name of many 63-octet labels encodes past 255 octets.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: No length octet is narrowed; each label still fits, so it is an RFC limit, not the CWE-197 truncation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Remove/plant a missing range check on the 16-bit length in put_length16.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding the 8-bit checks could plausibly have left the 16-bit length helper alone.

O9_family: integer truncation / narrowing of a wire-format length field (CWE-197)

O10_build.project_tests: test/resolv/test_dns.rb:599-795 already cover label, name, and character-string limits

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a > 63 check in put_string, which breaks legitimate 64..255-octet TXT strings.

out_of_scope_notes: Candidate looks mis-pinned: the real fix is commit b0ddbb5 ('Enforce DNS label and name size limits when encoding'), an ancestor of the pinned commit; re-pin to b0ddbb5^ if this advisory is to be used.
